# Interface

The network interfaces of the host.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/network/interface`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node network interface` |
| Jobs | `behavior.interface.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| [netplan](../netplan/netplan.md) | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `debian`, `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`create` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`update` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`delete` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

On linux it also runs `ip`.

On darwin it also runs `ifconfig`, `netstat`.

It runs `ethtool` when the host has it, and reads without it otherwise.

It writes `/etc/netplan/osapi-*.yaml`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.interface.<method>`, with `behavior.netplan.<method>`, `behavior.managedfile.<method>`, `exec ip`, `exec ifconfig`, `exec netstat`, `exec ethtool`, `exec netplan`, `exec chown`, `exec stat`, `file.write`, `file.remove`, `file.chmod`, `kv.get`, `kv.put` under it.

Its span records the input `name` (get, create, update, delete).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`list`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/interface/list.md) | read | `network:read` | List the network interfaces of the host |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/interface/get.md) | read | `network:read` | Get a network interface of the host |
| [`create`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/interface/create.md) | write | `network:write` | Configure a network interface |
| [`update`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/interface/update.md) | write | `network:write` | Change the config osapi has of a network interface |
| [`delete`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/interface/delete.md) | write | `network:write` | Drop the config osapi has of a network interface |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name interface                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name interface --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
